action_input.code:
import sqlite3

# Get SME customer IDs
conn1 = sqlite3.connect('/home/tako/urp/react/data/public/input/task_169/context/db/customers.db')
cursor1 = conn1.cursor()
cursor1.execute("SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'")
sme_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor1.fetchall()]
conn1.close()

# Calculate average consumption for SME customers in 2013
conn2 = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/data_agent_structured_sv3i7x9g.sqlite')
cursor2 = conn2.cursor()
cursor2.execute("SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID IN (" + ','.join(str(x) for x in sme_ids) + ") AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013'")
result = cursor2.fetchone()
conn2.close()

print(result[0] if result[0] else 'null')
print(f"Number of SME customers: {len(sme_ids)}")
print(f"Sample SME IDs: {sme_ids[:10]}")
